solar_market_value_october.question: What was the market value (capture price) of solar power in October 2026, and how does it compare with the official value?

input.a_label: Solar capture price, calculated from Energy-Charts solar generation and day-ahead prices, Oct 2026

content.text:
The solar market value (capture price) for October 2026 (1–31 Oct, German local time) was 13.449 ct/kWh (134.49 EUR/MWh). This is my calculation: day-ahead prices weighted by public net solar generation, with a capture rate of 79.45% against the average spot price of 16.927 ct/kWh.

The official figure is 13.39 ct/kWh, so my value is 0.059 ct/kWh (0.44%) higher. The official value is "reported" status, not final. It comes from the TSOs' monthly market value computation, which uses extrapolated feed-in, while my figure uses Energy-Charts' metered generation. The official netztransparenz definition expects small differences like this.

Source: Energy-Charts.info (Fraunhofer ISE); Bundesnetzagentur | SMARD.de (day-ahead prices); netztransparenz.de (German TSOs) via Solarserver (official monthly market value, reported 2026-11-10).
